requiredBindings.name: LEDGER
requiredBindings.purpose: The sole durable owner of work-item leases, actions, attempts, and receipts.

requiredBindings.name: RUNNER
requiredBindings.purpose: A disposable Cloudflare Sandbox/NanoCodex run capability with no persistent work state.

requiredBindings.name: GITHUB
requiredBindings.purpose: The repository-scoped GitHub App capability for issues, stack artifacts, and deterministic promotion dispatch.

deploymentGuard: Deploy only with matching private RPC entrypoints in the ledger, runner, and GitHub identity services. This package intentionally owns no durable action state.
